Auth Mon Bot: [ALERT] auth-service 401 spike across eu-west-1 & us-west-2 since 11:58 UTC :rotating_light:
Samir (Support): getting ~30 customer tickets, all 401 on API-key auth endpoing
Raj P: I can repro from my laptop. curl returns 401 with body: `\{"error\":\"invalid_client\",\"message\":\"token_not_found\"\}`
Maria K: timeline - nightly key rotation job kicked at 11:58 UTC, rolled keys to version v2026-03-15-1158 across all regions
Samir (Support): customers report immediately after rotation they started seeing 401s, some recovered after client retry but not all
Jose (Console): console shows failed introspects to `introspect.redwood.internal` - a lot of `404 key` responses in logs
Kevin (SRE): digging into auth pods now, tailing logs: `auth-service[worker-2]: lookup_key(session_id=abc): not found -> 404`
Raj P: repro steps I'm using:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXXXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
# response:
# HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
# {"error":"invalid_client","message":"token_not_found"}
```
Maria K: checking rotation job, there's a step that sets `token_storage.ttl` via config templating. commit `rotate-2026-03-15` changed default from `30d` to `30s` by accident (typo) :facepalm:
Samir (Support): ohhh that would explain immediate expiry for some tokens, but why are some clients still working?
Kevin (SRE): looks like cache layering: if a token was in KV cache (redis) prior to rotation, we still return ok until TTL; tokens validated via DB see the short TTL and get rejected. Different callers hit different validation paths (prefix cache vs direct DB).
Support Escalations: customers want ETA and mitigation steps now. We should first stop rotation and restore previous TTL.
sre-oncall-bot: @oncall runbook link https://runbooks.redwood.ai/auth/key-rotation contains rollback steps
Kevin (SRE): rolling back rotation config to previous commit now, will set `token_storage.ttl=2592000` (30d) and redeploy auth-service config
Raj P: after rollback, will clients with already-expired tokens need re-issue? yes any token with TTL<=30s that already expired will stay invalid. we need fallback acceptance for recently-rotated tokens for 10min window
Maria K: hotfix proposal: re-introduce temporary tolerant-introspection flag in auth-service that accepts tokens signed by previous signer for 10m; PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/auth/pulls/483
Samir (Support): can we do a temporary manual re-issue for impacted enterprise customers? we can server-side create new keys and send via support flow but prefer global fix first
Kevin (SRE): applying config rollback now (deploy configmap rotate-config -> previous). kicking rolling restart of auth pods (graceful).
Auth Mon Bot: configuration change deployed to prod at 12:06 UTC, beginning rolling restart (30 pods)
Raj P: testing again after config rollback - still seeing some 401s from region us-west-2
Kevin (SRE): investigating - looks like redis nodes in us-west-2 were restarted during rotation and lost in-memory cached token copies. we need to warm cache from DB. running `scripts/warm-token-cache --region us-west-2 --since 11:50`
Jose (Console): warming script shows progress, ~60% warmed after 4 mins, dashboard errors decreasing
Samir (Support): customers on older SDKs that pin to `introspect_v1` still failing because they use a different validation path that hits DB only
Maria K: mitigation - enable tolerant-introspection flag (PR 483) for 10m to accept tokens signed by previous key, and continue cache warming. also prepare customer communication explaining root cause and remediation steps.
Kevin (SRE): tolerant-introspection enabled at 12:12 UTC. monitoring 401/second metric.
Auth Mon Bot: 401 rate back to baseline in eu-west-1, residual errors in us-west-2 trending down :white_check_mark:
Support Escalations: draft sent to impacted customers with temporary key reissue offer and incident link (internal doc)
Samir (Support): collecting list of 12 enterprise customers who explicitly requested manual rotation fallback
Raj P: postmortem items:
- [P0] fix rotation templating validation to prevent TTL typos (owner: Maria K)
- [P1] add pre-rotation dry-run that validates produced config values (owner: Eng-Infra)
- [P1] make token-introspection fallback path consistent (owner: Kevin)
- [P2] add more robust cache persistence for redis warmups (owner: Eng-Platform)
- [P2] SDKs: surface deprecation/compatibility notes when server-side rotations occur (owner: Developer DX)

Kevin (SRE): created incident page https://incidents.redwood.ai/1923456789-sso-session-regen with timeline and artifacts. assigning follow-ups.
Maria K: uploading logs & rotation job policy diff to the incident doc now.
Samir (Support): closing active escalation once all 12 customers confirmed OK. will keep thread updated. thanks team :thumbsup:
Kevin (SRE): final note - hotfix reverted TTL typo, enabled tolerant introspection for 10m, warmed caches, and started PR to add CI checks that block TTL values < 1h for rotation jobs.
Samir (Support): marking incident as mitigated at 12:28 UTC; creating postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow.
Auth Mon Bot: incident status -> mitigated :white_check_mark:
